hero.title: A neighborhood cafe with its head in the stars.
hero.body: Mars Cafe is a retro space-diner inspired stop for carefully made coffee, warm pastries, and everyday escapes from Earth.

paragraphs.text: Mars Cafe began with a simple idea: a great cup of coffee can make an ordinary day feel like a small adventure.
We blend serious coffee craft with the bright optimism of mid-century space travel—welcoming booths, cosmic color, and a menu made for every orbit.

items.title: Coffee with intention
items.body: Thoughtfully prepared drinks, from the first espresso pull to the final pour.

items.title: A little wonder
items.body: A playful place to pause, connect, and take the long way through your day.

items.title: Warm welcomes
items.body: Good coffee tastes even better when everyone has a seat at the table.

visit.title: Come find your orbit.
visit.body: Drop in for a slow morning, a quick refuel, or a coffee worth lingering over.
